items.event_time_ist: Monday afternoon, Oct 12, 2026 (San Blas, Nayarit local time)
items.summary: Seawater flooding was reported Monday afternoon in at least three neighborhoods of San Blas, Nayarit — including Benito Juárez — with some residents moving to shelters. It is the first verified neighborhood-level flood impact from Hurricane Simon in Nayarit, which remains under a hurricane watch; Puerto Vallarta's earlier Monday conditions were described as less severe than feared.
items.title: Seawater flooding hits San Blas, Nayarit; residents moved to shelters

items.event_time_ist: Planned 12:01 AM Tue, Oct 13, 2026 (Puerto Vallarta local time)
items.summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico (GAP) announced a planned resumption of commercial operations at Puerto Vallarta airport at 12:01 a.m. Tuesday, Oct 13 (per La Jornada, via Drive Mexico Magazine's Monday evening report). Caveat: GAP's official Oct 11 NOTAM-based notice said the airport would stay closed until 8:00 a.m. local Tue Oct 13 — the two announced times conflict, so treat the reopening time as unconfirmed until GAP's official channels confirm. Ports at Puerto Vallarta and San Blas remained closed to navigation Monday evening.
items.title: GAP plans Puerto Vallarta airport reopening 12:01 AM Tue — earlier than official 8 AM notice
